BiblicalUsage: Chliaros is lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, and it stands once, in the letter to Laodicea. The Lord says He knows their works, that they are neither cold nor hot, and because they are lukewarm He will spue them out of His mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lukewarmness is the most dangerous state a church can be in, because it feels safe while it is sick, and the Lord's threat is mercy in disguise, since He would rather we were cold and honest than warm and self-deceived.
RelatedEvents: The Letter to the Church in Laodicea
